metadata.title: fix: If auth is disabled, use the default user for dependency injection
metadata.author: gabe-l-hart

description:
Branch: DisabledAuthAPI

Currently, even with `AUTH_REQUIRED=false`, any endpoint that depends on the `user` will raise a `401` for a call without a token. This check fixes that by using the default admin user when no token is present and auth is disabled.

commits.message:
fix: If auth is disabled, use the default user for dependency injection

Branch: LazyImports
